import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for total spending on products
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                           'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Income and Total Spending
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Education', data=df, palette='viridis', alpha=0.7)

# Adding labels and title
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.legend(title='Education Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
